scope: Existing isolated same-Edge direct-stage evidence only: three bundled works, four viewports, two times, requestVideoFrameCallback and RAF fallback; pause, seek, resize, skip, end cleanup and controlled visibility. No tests were rerun when preparing this summary.

coverage.backgroundSampling: Only when padding exists; 8x1 Canvas, at least 250 ms between samples, scheduled off the frame callback through idle/timer tasks.

interpretation: In the recorded approximately 3.25-second samples, full-frame Canvas copies fell from 91/92 to zero. Landscape readbacks fell from 92 to zero; portrait readbacks fell from 91 to 12. These are measured workload reductions, not proof of one exclusive stutter cause or a universal smoothness guarantee.
limitations: Headless Edge playback-quality and callback timing are local observations, not a guarantee for every GPU or system load.
Visibility is tested via a controlled document.hidden getter and real visibilitychange handler, not an OS minimize operation.
Legacy preservation test uses a minimal procedural composition; its existing rendering algorithm was not changed.
Both old and new samples reported zero dropped frames in this headless Edge run; those counters do not demonstrate that the user-reported intermittent drops have been eliminated.
This direct-stage report does not cover the later compiled-client rebuild, production DSH restart or whole-system GPU scheduling; those are separate validation steps.
